subject: Dedicated cluster footprint choices + onboarding timeline — Lumenia
messages:

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Dedicated cluster footprint choices + onboarding timeline — Lumenia

Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is a concise set of reservation options tuned to the workload profile you shared (batch inference + low-latency chat spikes). I put two recommended paths so we can keep commercial and runway trade-offs explicit:

Option A — Minimal guaranteed floor (cost-conservative)
- Cluster: 8 A100-80GB equivalent GPUs (shared across models)
- Min GPUs: 4 guaranteed baseline (keeps latency tight for production traffic)
- Ramp: 4 → 8 across 60 days in three tranches (2-week validation windows)
- Ideal when you need predictable spend and can accept restricted burst capacity

Option B — Higher floor for aggressive scale and smoother tail latency
- Cluster: 16 A100-80GB equivalent GPUs
- Min GPUs: 10 guaranteed baseline
- Ramp: 6 → 10 → 16 over 45 days with early burst credits for initial launch
- Better for heavy peak usage and lower risk of throttling during marketing spikes

I've included an onboarding timeline (spreadsheet) that maps activation milestones (deployment, canary load, data residency proof, security sign-off). Please review the trade-offs and tell me which path you prefer or if you'd like a hybrid (start A, convert to B at month 3).

Next steps I suggest:
- You indicate preferred option and any regulatory constraints by Fri 21 Jul
- If you choose Option B, we'll align pricing with a 12-month commitment and include 3 weeks of pre-launch burst credits
- I'll loop in Karthik to finalize contract-level floors/credits once you pick an option

Attachments: LUM-ReservedOptions-v2.pdf (detailed sizing + pricing), lumenia-onboarding-timeline.xlsx

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Thanks Soojin — quick clarifying questions before we pick:

1) For Option A, can we get short-term burst beyond 8 GPUs during the first 2 weeks of launch? We expect an unpredictable marketing spike.
2) For Option B, what does the pricing break look like if we commit for 6 months vs 12 months?
3) The timeline references "data residency proof" — our security team will need a checklist. Who on your side handles that?

Appreciate the clear options — I think we lean toward a small floor (A) but want the ability to burst immediately if needed.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Engineering, Lumenia

On Wed, 18 Jul 2028 at 10:08 AM Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenia.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Soojin — quick clarifying questions before we pick:
>
> 1) For Option A, can we get short-term burst beyond 8 GPUs during the first 2 weeks of launch? We expect an unpredictable marketing spike.
>
> 2) For Option B, what does the pricing break look like if we commit for 6 months vs 12 months?
>
> 3) The timeline references "data residency proof" — our security team will need a checklist. Who on your side handles that?

Great questions — answers below inline.

1) Short-term burst on Option A: yes. We can provision a burst window (up to +50% GPUs for 14 days) as a paid burst add-on or tie it to a modest short-term credit. I noted a 14-day early-burst option in the PDF (section 3). The burst is subject to capacity availability in your region but we will prioritize canary windows for customers in onboarding.

2) Pricing for Option B: 6-month commit is ~8% higher in effective per-GPU-hour cost compared to 12-month. I'll have Karthik share the exact pricing tiers (6m vs 12m) in the next email — want to make sure commercial gets the preferred term.

3) Data residency checklist: Grace will own that checklist and provide the proof artifacts (VPC config, audit log examples, KMS integration notes). Grace — can you drop the checklist we use for Private deployments into the Drive folder shared in the thread?

If that approach looks good, please signal preference for Option A with burst or Option B and we'll move to commercial redlines.

Thanks,
Soojin

Thanks — Priya here (ops).

We prefer starting on Option A with the 14-day burst window for launch. Two asks:

- Can Redwood commit to a 4-hour response SLA for scaling incidents during the first 30 days post-launch? Our SRE team needs a warm handoff window.
- Please include a line item for a one-time onboarding services fee (deployment & validation) and an estimated number of Redwood engineering days.

If you include those items in the quote, we're fine to move forward and bring legal into the loop.

Best,

Looping in commercial touchpoints. Pricing and contract notes for Option A + 14-day burst:
- Baseline: 8 GPUs reserved, 4 GPU minimum guaranteed
- Burst: up to +4 GPUs (total 12) for the first 14 days at 60% of base per-GPU-hour rate (one-time burst credit applied)
- Onboarding services: estimated 6 engineering days (Redwood eng), one-time fee $18,000 (covers deployment validation, observability hooks, and runbook handoff)
- SLA: we can offer a 4-hour operational response for scaling incidents in the first 30 days; after that standard enterprise SLA applies.

Grace — I'll need the security checklist link and any sample artifacts to attach to the quote. Once Soojin gets verbal confirmation from Lumenia, I'll produce the redline-ready quote and include a term comparison matrix (6m vs 12m).

Thanks,
